build_RAG_instance: build a RAG instance that loads example prompts and builds sentence embeddings for retrieval
build_data_embedding: build sentence embeddings for all instructions in the RAG dataset using all-mpnet-base-v2
load_data_llm: load example prompts from trace or prompt files filtered by successful episodes
retrieve_top_k_given_query: retrieve the top k most similar examples given a query string and agent id
run_RAG_retrieval: run the RAG module to find closest instructions to a task query and print results
